labels.annotator_rationale: In unsafeSqlLookup (lines 24-29), untrusted HTTP parameter request.getParameter("username") at line 25 is concatenated directly into the SQL string at line 26 and executed via Statement.executeQuery(query) at line 28 without parameterization or escaping.

In unsafeFileRead (lines 31-35), untrusted HTTP parameter request.getParameter("report") at line 32 is concatenated directly into new File("/var/app/reports/" + rawReportName) at line 33 and opened via FileInputStream at line 34 without path normalization or prefix containment checks.

In safeFileRead (lines 44-49), rawReportName from request.getParameter("report") (line 45) is sanitized via Apache Commons IO FilenameUtils.getName(rawReportName) at line 46 before concatenation into new File("/var/app/reports/" + cleanName) at line 47. FilenameUtils.getName strips all directory prefixes and '/' or '\\' separators, preventing CWE-22 directory traversal outside /var/app/reports/ (degenerate inputs '', '.', '..' resolve to directories and fail with FileNotFoundException on FileInputStream).
